Theater v7 Jun 2026
Features
Logistics: ammo & fuel — all units carry ammo (0-100%) and fuel (0-100%). Ammo depletes per shot by type; fuel depletes per movement. Low ammo: reduced damage. Empty fuel: immobilised.
Supply trucks — new unit class. Drives to needy friendlies, resupplies ammo and fuel within radius. Prioritised as enemy targets.
Supply depots — two depots per side in deep rear. Trucks return to restock; depots slowly regenerate. Rendered on 3D terrain as ⊞ icons.
Theater v6 Jun 2026
Bug Fixes
Fullscreen map fixed — panels now correctly collapse without breaking the canvas resize. Uses CSS grid column zeroing instead of display:none.
EW jamming — jamFor moved to module scope so fireAt() can correctly read jam values. Previously always 0.
Kill matrix — allKm now initialized from full TKEYS array (includes dro/ew). Previously crashed on drone kills.
Drone kamikaze — self-detonation rewritten to avoid recursive killUnit calls. Drones now correctly explode, spawn operator, and deal area splash without double-counting losses.
powerOf() — now sums all 7 TKEYS dynamically. Previously excluded arty/nav/dro/ew from power calculations.
km[] safe access — kill matrix now uses optional chaining throughout to prevent undefined key errors from dynamically spawned units.
New Features
Formations — 8 custom formations selectable per side before battle: Line, Wedge, Echelon, Column, Pincer, Dispersed, Refused Flank, Box. Each uses a spatial layout function mapping units across the deployment band. Artillery always hangs back; air and drones push forward relative to the formation depth. UI shows glyph buttons in the left panel with descriptions.
Formation depth bias — each formation has per-type depth offsets (typeOffset). Arty stays deep (−0.10 to −0.20 band), drones/air push forward (+0.05 to +0.12).
Theater v5 Jun 2026
New Features
Dove bombing drones — air-launched kamikaze drones. On death, surviving operator spawns as Rifleman infantry at last known position.
Electronic Warfare vehicles — EW units (Krasukha/SEWS) do not fire. Instead they radiate jamming that degrades nearby enemy range, accuracy, and cooldown by 15-35%. Visual pulse ring shows jamming radius.
Fullscreen map — click ⛶ in the header to collapse both side panels and give the terrain full screen. Click again to restore.
Patch Notes tab — this drawer, pinned to the bottom bar. Click "Patch Notes" to open/close.
Descriptive unit icons — all 7 unit classes now render bespoke 2D silhouettes drawn via Canvas: MBT with rotating turret ring, IFV with APC body, helicopter with rotor arc, jets with swept delta shape, naval hull, arty diamond+barrel, infantry dot-triangle. EW vehicles show green pulse rings.
Mechanics
Drone lifecycle — Kamikaze Dove drones have 60% HP of normal air units, deal splash damage on death (self-destruct), and leave an operator unit (Rifleman) at the point where the drone spawned. Operators move slowly and will engage nearby enemies as infantry once the drone dies.
EW jamming model — each EW vehicle has a jam radius (based on Krasukha-4: 150-300km effective, scaled to sim). Enemy units within radius suffer: –20% effective range, –15% damage, +25% cooldown. Multiple EW units stack up to a 40% cap.
EW visibility — EW vehicles appear as ⊘ on the map with an animated green ring. They do not attack and their HP pool is reduced (low priority target for the sim's targeting AI).
Balance Changes (v4 → v5)
Drone base HP reduced 22 → 16 to reflect fragility of small UAVs.
Interceptor range bonus vs air increased; now correctly counters drones.
MANPADS air dmgOver multiplier 6.0 → 7.0 to better represent SA-18S Igla-Super effectiveness.
Submarine nav dmgOver corrected from 3.0 → 4.0 (torpedo lethality vs surface ships).
Visual Changes
Unit rendering — switched from basic glyphs to Canvas path silhouettes per unit class. Subtype glyph still shown as a small overlay label. HP bar improved: thicker with smoother color gradient.
EW pulse — animated CSS radial ring on EW vehicles gives battlefield EW visibility without cluttering the terrain render.
Water terrain — Water/Coast biomes now rendered with a subtle shimmer and darker shade to distinguish from land.
